accueil.titre: Find your team, build your project, put it online.
accueil.texte: Jamii brings African developers together: communities to help each other, small business requests to deliver as a team, and projects that live on after the hackathon.

profil.vide: Your profile will fill up with your public GitHub languages and projects, and the projects you put online on Jamii.

generation.texte: Jamii reads your public repositories (languages, topics, stars) to fill in your profile. Nothing private is read, and you can complete everything afterwards.
generation.prive: Your profile stays private until you publish it.
generation.sansGithub: Your account is not linked to GitHub. Sign in with GitHub to generate your profile.
generation.tropSouvent: You have already updated your profile several times this hour. Try again a little later.

erreurs.github_indisponible: GitHub is not responding right now. Your previous profile is kept: try again in a few minutes.
erreurs.github_refus: GitHub can no longer find your account. Check your GitHub username, then try again.

visibilite.prive: 🔒 Your profile is private: only you can see it.
visibilite.publie: ✅ Your profile is published: signed-in members can see it and invite you to a team.

modifier.competencesAide: Separated by commas, 20 at most. Example: UX design, Mobile Money
modifier.conflit: Your profile changed in another tab. Here is the latest version: please make your change again.

langages.estimation: Estimated from the size of your public GitHub repositories (forks excluded).

competences.source: Deduced from your GitHub repositories, plus the ones you add.

projets.vide: No project yet. The projects you put online with your team will appear here, with the verified link.

depots.pasUnePreuve: Repositories show what you code. Only a project that is online and verified counts as proof.

etat.indisponible: Jamii is not responding right now. Try again in a moment.

systalink.intro: What Jamii brings to the Systalink cloud. Figures are aggregated and anonymous: no individual appears.
systalink.partDatacloud: {part}% of online projects are hosted on DataCloud
systalink.seuilPays: A country appears once it has 5 members, so that no one can be identified.
systalink.momentsIntro: Jamii offers a Systalink service at the right moment: DataCloud to put a project online, Orion for a small business website… Here is how often, and how many people followed it.
systalink.momentsVide: No service offered in this period.
systalink.nonMesure: Moving to a paid plan is not measured: Jamii cannot see purchases made at Systalink.

vitrine.intro: Projects born on Jamii and actually online. Every address responded less than 24 hours ago.

communautes.intro: Ask questions, help others and show your projects, with developers from across the continent.
communautes.questionsOuvertes: no open question | {n} open question | {n} open questions
communautes.aideIa: For a question, the AI will suggest an answer. A community member will have to check it.
communautes.erreurPublier: Your post could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
communautes.rejoindrePourPublier: Join the community to post and answer.
communautes.vide: Nothing here yet. Ask the first question!

question.iaPrepare: The AI is preparing an answer…
question.iaIndisponible: The AI did not suggest an answer. Community members can answer.
question.proposeeParIa: Suggested by the AI · to be checked by a peer
question.attendUnPair: Another community member must check this answer.
question.merciValidation: Thank you! Your check makes this answer reliable for everyone.
question.merciAcceptation: 🎉 Answer accepted. It now appears on its author’s profile.

erreurs.pas_membre: Join the community to do this.
erreurs.pas_auteur_question: Only the author of the question can accept an answer.
erreurs.propre_question: You cannot confirm the answer to your own question: another member must do it.
erreurs.deja_acceptee: This question already has an accepted answer.
erreurs.autre: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

designSystem.intro: Jamii's visual identity, as the app uses it. Every colour comes from docs/design/tokens.json, and contrasts are computed live.
designSystem.marqueAide: A brand only changes the action colour. The orange used for proof stays the same everywhere.
designSystem.contrastesAide: Measured on the theme and brand shown. WCAG 2.1 AA thresholds: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for borders and focus.

exemples.iaTexte: Dashed until a human accepts it: it is not proof yet.
